Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Kickoff & evaluation timeline — intro + logistics

Hi Sasha — great talking earlier. Per our conversation I’m sending a short MAP kickoff note to align stakeholders and lock logistics for the evaluation sprint. Objectives: confirm success criteria, agree on evaluation dataset & access, and set a close timeline so we can scope Dedicated capacity if needed.

Proposed 60-minute kickoff windows (PDT):
- Option A: Wed Aug 11, 10:00–11:00am PDT
- Option B: Thu Aug 12, 9:00–10:00am PDT

Please tell me: who from Acme TeleMed should be on the call (product/ML/infra/security) and which time works best. I’ve attached a working MAP draft and a short agenda — both are intentionally light so we can evolve the MAP during the kickoff.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.docx, kickoff-agenda.pdf

Quick notes:
- Karthik (SE) & Priyom (CSM) will lead the evaluation plan discussion and proposed test matrix.
- We’ll send a Zoom link once we confirm time and will add a short pre-kick checklist (data access + sample queries) to the Drive folder.
- Target close window: 6–8 weeks from kickoff depending on model/eval scope; we’ll refine that in the meeting.

Thanks — looking forward to getting your stakeholder roster.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Thanks Sasha — Wed Aug 11 at 10:00am PDT is confirmed. I've added calendar invites to all internal participants and will send the Acme invite when I get confirmation of the attendee emails (Omar, Priya).

Zoom link (placeholder): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=mapkickoff
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleDriveID
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4782

Attached is a short kickoff agenda (PDF) and the MAP draft (Word) — please review sections in the MAP labeled "Success criteria" and "Data & access." A couple of preflight items for Acme:
- Provide CSV sample (<= 10k rows) and a read-only S3 path or secure share by Tue Aug 10 EOD PDT.
- Confirm who will receive admin access to the Redwood test project (Omar recommended).
- Share any compliance constraints (e.g., PHI handling rules) for the eval so we can route to security ahead of time.

Priyom — can you add a short evaluation matrix in the MAP (3 tiers: smoke / accuracy / scale) before the call? Karthik, can you prepare a 10-min tech preflight checklist for Omar (networking ports, sample ingest steps, expected token volumes)?

Thanks all — I’ll post the final invite with Zoom once I have the attendee list.

Best,
Maya

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Sasha Wright <sasha.wright@acme-telemed.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Kickoff & evaluation timeline — confirmed Wed 10am PDT (tech notes)

Thanks — quick tech notes to seed the kickoff so we can hit the evaluation windows:

- Suggested model matrix for 100k-message sample:
  * small (quantized 7B) — smoke tests, latency baseline
  * medium (8–13B) — accuracy/throughput tradeoffs
  * large (30B float16) — worst-case quality, compare cost

- Preflight checklist (10 items) I’ll run with Omar prior to the kickoff:
  1) Confirm S3 read path + IAM role (or share temp creds)
  2) Sample CSV format check (one message per row, id, timestamp, text)
  3) Confirm target latency SLOs and expected concurrency
  4) Network egress rules (we'll provide IP ranges if needed)
  5) Tokenization sanity check (we'll send sample token counts)
  6) Required redaction / PHI handling guidance
  7) Any throttling on their side during ingest
  8) Contact for infra escalations (Omar)
  9) Timezone confirmation for test run windows
  10) Point person for results review

- If Acme prefers we can run the initial ingest on Redwood Dedicated with a small reserved pool to give predictable throughput — we’ll propose sizing after seeing the sample.

I’ll be on the kickoff to walk through the technical plan and the evaluation matrix.

Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
